# fw docs

> Reference of the fw docs command: Resolve and query library docs from crates.io, npm, PyPI, GitHub and llms.txt, cached locally. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/docs/

Resolve and query library docs from crates.io, npm, PyPI, GitHub and llms.txt, cached locally

## Usage

```bash
fw docs <resolve|query|ingest|list> [lib] [topic] [--tokens 4000]
```

## Aliases

`fw c7` runs `fw docs`. `fw context7` runs `fw docs`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw docs resolve
fw docs query
fw docs ingest
fw docs list
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--tokens` | `4000` |

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
